verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state the API supports 'remote MCP servers' as an extensible tool type alongside function calling and built-in tools (gpt-docs-24), confirming MCP server plug-in support at the platform level. However, there is no dedicated MCP guide, no setup/config walkthrough, and no independent/hands-on confirmation of the feature in the evidence pack. missing for 10: a dedicated MCP integration guide/tutorial, example code wiring a remote MCP server into a request, and independent or community corroboration of it working.
